scope: Lake Superior fishing-guide license and Duluth charter fishing departures
recommended_first_source: The 2026 compilation of Minnesota Statutes, section 97C.311 (https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/97C.311) is the person license to operate a charter boat and guide anglers on Lake Superior or the defined St. Louis River Estuary. It is not a roster. The commercial catalog row for that license (https://www.dnr.state.mn.us/licenses/commercial/index.html) has no roster link.
highest_priority_permission_question: No public guide roster was found. Do the Department copyright notice or Minnesota Statutes chapter 13 authorize copying licensee or hull fields into a commercial directory or claiming a listing? The notice checked on 2026-11-25 requires permission for commercial publication. Chapter 13 was not opened. The Visit Duluth directory reserves all rights.
